rubrics.justification: It correctly interprets 1DD as very poor quality with absent/degenerative ICM and TE, but it misstates expansion as an early blastocyst with minimal cavitation; Gardner 1 means blastocoel at least half the embryo, and no image was available to support additional visual claims.
It integrates age, ovarian response, prior IVF outcomes, sperm parameters, endometrium, BMI, diagnosis, and lifestyle reasonably well, though some links to embryo quality are speculative.

Overall logic is structured and consistent, but several conclusions are overreaching from limited data, especially inferring progressive decline, over-suppression, and assigning a precise probability from uncertain assumptions.

Much of the counseling is broadly IVF-consistent, but recommendations such as routine ERA, thrombophilia/immunology testing, universal ICSI, and DHEA are not strongly guideline-supported for this presentation.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for current transfer counseling and future cycle planning, though some suggested tests/interventions may be excessive or insufficiently evidence-based.
